title: Particle Physics Engine
blurb: Lightweight canvas particle physics with continuous morphing and text repulsion.
body: An interactive particle simulation built with raw HTML5 Canvas 2D and Spring dynamics. Designed for buttery smooth 60fps across low-end mobile and high-refresh desktop monitors.

title: Galaxy Effort Bar
blurb: Pastel spectral progress and workload visualization with fluid gradient transitions.
body: A craft-focused progress bar component that samples colors from cool to warm pastels, rendering dynamic effort metrics and state transitions.

title: Adaptive Notch Nav
blurb: Dynamic pill navigation inspired by handheld consoles and mechanical hardware.
body: A top-docked navigation bar featuring concave SVG shoulders, spring morphing widths, pixel glyph indicators, and keyboard first accessibility.
